Vocabulary Quiz: Functions
Name: __________

Matching. Write the letter of the definition next to each term.
1. Domain            A. The set of all outputs
2. Range             B. The set of all inputs
3. Slope             C. Rise over run
4. Intercept         D. Where a graph crosses an axis

Fill in the blank.
5. The slope of y = 4x - 1 is ______.
6. If f(x) = x^2, then f(3) = ______.

Answer Key
1. B 2. A 3. C 4. D 5. 4 6. 9
